Now I have the full picture of the pattern used (dialog-based feature mirrored off Inventory/Shop). Here's the file-by-file plan:

## Worker (backend)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| **`worker/migrations/0002_add_inn_rest.sql`** (new) | Add an `inns` table (`id, name, location, rest_cost`) or simpler: add `rest_cost INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5` column to existing `shops` table and seed an inn row. |
| **`worker/src/types/index.ts`** | Add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: string; innId: number }` interface; optionally `INN_REST_COST` constant if cost is fixed rather than per-row. |
| **`worker/src/routes/rest.ts`** (new, mirrors `shop.ts`) | `restRoutes.post('/')`: load character via `getCharacter`, look up inn/cost, verify `character.gold >= cost`, then `updateCharacter(db, id, { gold: character.gold - cost, hp: character.max_hp })`; return updated character/gold. |
| **`worker/src/index.ts`** | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. |
| **`worker/src/services/character.ts`** | No change needed — `updateCharacter` already accepts `hp` and `gold` in its `Partial<Pick<...>>` type. |

## Frontend (Angular)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| **`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`** | Add `RestResponse { success: boolean; updatedHp: number; updatedGold: number }` (and `Inn`/cost type if needed). |
| **`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`** | Add `restAtInn(sessionId, characterId, innId): Observable<RestResponse>` → `POST /api/rest`. |
| **`frontend/src/app/components/inn/inn.component.ts` + `.html` + `.css`** (new, mirrors `inventory.component.*`) | Dialog showing gold cost / current HP, a "Rest" button calling `restAtInn`, updates `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(...)` with new `hp`/`gold`, shows snackbar confirmation/error (e.g. "Not enough gold"). |
| **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts`** | Import `InnComponent`, add `openInn()` method (mirrors `openInventory()` at line 237) opening the dialog via `MatDialog`. |
| **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html`** | Add a "Rest at Inn" button (near existing Inventory button) calling `openInn()`. |
| **`frontend/src/app/services/character-state.service.ts`** | No change needed — `setCharacter` already recomputes `hpPercent` from updated `hp`/`max_hp`. |

No changes needed to `character.ts` worker service or DB schema beyond the migration, since `characters.hp`/`gold` columns already exist.
